description:
Join our data platform group and build dependable services used by teams across the organisation.

You will design batch and streaming pipelines, improve observability, automate deployment and testing, and partner with analysts and application engineers on clear data contracts.
descriptionPlain: Join our data platform group and build dependable services used by teams across the organisation.

lists.content:
• Build production pipelines using Python and SQL.
  • Improve data quality and production monitoring.
  • Review designs and explain technical trade-offs.

• Experience delivering production data systems.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Cloud and infrastructure-as-code experience is useful.

additional: We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.
additionalPlain: We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.
